ModMetaData.name: CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms Compatibility Module - Tactics
ModMetaData.author: eebette
ModMetaData.description:
Opt-in combat-time weapon-choice enhancements for the Combat Extended + Simple Sidearms combination. Every feature is OFF by default.
- Reload-abort when threatened: a pawn mid-reload with a hostile in effective range swaps to a loaded carried weapon instead of finishing the reload (player-ordered reloads are never interrupted). - Forced-weapon dry fall-through: a pawn forced onto a weapon that is completely out of ammo temporarily uses normal weapon selection; the forced weapon resumes the moment ammo is available again. - Ammo-depth tiebreak: when two carried guns rank about equally, prefer the one with deeper ammo reserves.
Requires the CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms Compatibility Patch.
